**Rides Bar & Grill is the place to be for Fruita Fall Festival week!** 🎉🎡✨

*(Note: Our parking lot will be completely closed to vehicle parking and blocked off for pedestrians to fully support the parade and festival fun!)* 🚶‍♂️🚗🚫

Here is your full weekly lineup:

🏈 **Monday Night:** Catch **Monday Night Football** on our screens! Grab a cold bottled beverage and enjoy your favorite burgers or bites.
🎵 **Tuesday Night:** Our signature **Tuesday Blues Jam**! Kick things off with some incredible local live music.
🎤 **Wednesday Night (7:00 PM - Midnight):** **Karaoke Night**! Warm up those vocal cords and take the mic.
🎤 **Friday:** **All-Day Karaoke**! Come on by, show us your talent, and belt out your favorite tunes as festival weekend kicks off.
🎧 **Friday & Saturday Late Night:** Our **DJ is spinning and taking requests until 2:00 AM** both nights to keep the party going!
⏰ **Saturday Morning @ 9:30 AM:** Doors open early for the big parade! Grab the absolute best viewing spot in town. Come on by to grab a fresh breakfast burrito or an early signature burger.

🎨 **All Weekend:** We are looking for talented local artists who want to paint a mural here at Rides—drop by to chat about getting involved!

Fuel up with our signature burgers made with fresh, locally sourced ground beef from Lazy 3x Ranch—cooked hot and fresh right out of our kitchen. Grab a cold bottled beer or cocktail, hit the dance floor, and let’s make it a week to remember. 🍔🍹🎶🎧🎨

Does anyone know how to reach Waste Management? I live in Fruita, but my house is technically in county limits, not city limits. Therefore my service is through the company themselves not the city. When I call the 800 number the call wont go through. My husband and I have just had so many issues with their service the last fee months. I was told my trash would be dumped on tuesdays, but that only happened the first month of my service. The company has gone as far as not dumping my trash can all the way, not picking it up until I fill out a missed pick up form, or picking up my recycling but not my trash can. I've even left a negative Google review for the company and nothing has changed. In addition, they won't let me take my bill off autpay. Im grateful for all the sanitation workers, but this is getting extremely frustrating. Thanks to everyone in advance.

✔️Found a bull we have been looking for and got him through a gate with some other cows.

✔️Caught a group of cows that were on the wrong side of a fence where a gate was left open.

✔️Put out salt.

✔️Checked water sources, including ponds and tanks.

✔️Never tightened the cinch and stepped in the saddle.

✔️A lot of bumpy miles in a side x side.

We took horses to the mountain, in case we needed them.

In the past, it would have taken someone 3-5 days to make the circle we made today. Checking water, distributing salt, checking health and well-being, looking at feed resources, fixing a hole in a fence, just being on the landacape and monitoring all of it.

It would have been done on a horse, today we made the miles on an ATV, with the horses on stand by, if needed. 

It was a good day.
